incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: Elevated runtime latency and queue growth observed for /v1/generate across prod clusters. Error mix: 429 throttles + sporadic 5xx on long-running kernels. Paging @mike oncall.

mike oncall: Acknowledged, pulling up cluster metrics and request traces.

sasha: Seeing worker-level inflight saturation on model rdx-7b-v2. Per-worker in_flight now ~18-22, historical normal ~6-8. KV cache response latency increased from 2ms -> 90ms which is causing prefix cache misses and more backend work.

julia-support: Customers reporting increased tail latency in status channel; several are hitting client-side retries.

ana: Probable feedback loop: higher cache latency -> more work -> longer holding of GPU streams -> higher in-flight -> head-of-line blocking. Immediate actions: (1) lower per-worker inflight limit for rdx-7b-v2 to 6; (2) enable aggressive queue aging so >12s gets shed; (3) temp rate-limit bursty selectors to smooth spikes.

mike oncall: I'll make config changes. Plan: patch runtime config via infra API, apply rate-limit for selectors with tag:burst, and flip off experimental async_streaming flag on rdx-7b-v2 which we've seen eat extra resources.

mike oncall: Runtime change payload (sent):
```json
{
  "scope":"prod",
  "changes":[
    {"param":"concurrency_per_worker","model":"rdx-7b-v2","value":"6"},
    {"param":"queue_age_limit_ms","value":"12000"},
    {"param":"request_timeout_ms","value":"45000"}
  ]
}
```

ops-bot: change accepted change_id=chg_2626031501, rolling across us-east-1, eu-central-1. Expected rollout 6m.

mike oncall: Applied feature toggle to disable async_streaming on rdx-7b-v2:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.ai/v1/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MITIGATE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"flag":"async_streaming","model":"rdx-7b-v2","state":"off","scope":"prod"}'
```

ops-bot: feature flag updated: async_streaming(rdx-7b-v2)=off, id=flag_2626_01.

sasha: After initial roll, p95 down from ~3.6s -> ~1.2s in eu-central-1. Queue depth reduced ~70%. A few heavy clients still see 429s.

julia-support: I posted a short note to the status page and DM'd top 5 customers. Some asked for temporary quota increases.

ana: For enterprise customers impacted, let's carve out a temporary higher burst quota instead of global bump. Use selector tag:enterprise-hotlist and add +40% qps for 15m window.

mike oncall: Executing quota patch for selector:enterprise-hotlist. Command:
```python
admin.patch('/quotas', json={
  'selector':'tag:enterprise-hotlist',
  'changes':{'burst_qps_delta':40, 'ttl_minutes':15}
})
```

incident-bot: quota update applied id=quota_2626_42.

sasha: Also enabling soft shedding for requests exceeding 30s to ensure kernels aren't held indefinitely. Shedding policy id=shd_2626_a.

ana: After these mitigations, cache miss amplification reduced. However need follow-ups: - make KV cache backpressure-aware (dont let slow cache stall workers), - adaptive concurrency per-model based on tail-latency, - add per-client retry-jitter guidance. I'll file follow-ups and tag infra/runtime.

beth-cust-sre: Confirmed decreased customer error volume but one large customer still saw retries due to client retry policy. We suggested reducing their client-side maxRetries to avoid overload.

mike oncall: I'll handoff to ana to own RCA and long-term fixes. Leaving page now; mitigations active and will be held for 25m before gradual rollback if stable.

ana: Acknowledged. I'll compile timeline, collect traces (esp. KV latency histograms) and schedule cross-team postmortem. Initial root-cause hypothesis: cache degradation combined with an experiment that increased per-request resource hold time.

incident-bot: Incident logged INC-2026-0427 severity=SEV2 mitigations=[concurrency_limit,queue_aging,feature_toggle,quota_scoped] owner=ana.

sasha: Longer term: implement adaptive inflight and a backpressure signal from cache clients. Marking infra backlog P0 for next sprint.

ana: I'll coordinate with product to ensure experimental flags have rollback playbooks. Opening ticket PM-3145.

mike oncall: Thanks team. Closing page. :white_check_mark:
